title: Add deterministic PIT counter progression for timer reads
description: The measured startup now programs PIT channel 0 in mode 3 with a zero divisor, which the host normalizes to 65536. Current PIT reads return the reload value forever; that is insufficient for later timer polling in menu/gameplay. Add a deterministic guest-cycle counter advanced by the Unicorn instruction hook, implement 8253 low/high and latched count reads from the virtual counter, and test monotonic decrement, wrap, latching, reload reset, and unrelated-port traps. Preserve reproducibility without wall-clock dependence.
acceptance: PIT counter reads change only as explicit guest virtual cycles advance
Low/high access and latched reads return the expected channel count bytes
Zero divisor wraps as 65536 and reload resets channel phase
The Unicorn original-byte probe remains deterministic and preserves PIT startup writes
Host-device, DOS service and Unicorn regression suites pass
